name: Whistler's Whim

perks.name: Agile Bowstring
perks.desc:
Durable yet light bowstring.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Tactile String
perks.desc:
Stable, high-friction bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Elastic String
perks.desc:
Excellent snapback.
  •  Decreases accuracy
  •  Faster draw time
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Flexible String
perks.desc:
Light and easy to draw.
  •  Slightly faster draw time
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: High Tension String
perks.desc:
Tightly strung bow.
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly slower draw time
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Natural String
perks.desc:
Simple balanced string.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Polymer String
perks.desc:
Unbreakable bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly faster draw time

perks.name: Carbon Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Light and stable shaft material. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Compact Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Thinner arrows to increase nocking speed and weapon handling.
  •  Increases handling speed 
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Fiberglass Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Heavy and consistent. 
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Helical Fletching
perks.desc:
Aerodynamic and light. 
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Natural Fletching
perks.desc:
Feather-light with good control.
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Greatly increases stability

perks.name: Straight Fletching
perks.desc:
Modern fletching for straight paths. 
  •  Increases accuracy

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.desc: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.desc: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

perks.name: Veist Stinger
perks.desc: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Draw Time. Lightweight(850) Kinetic Combat Bow Primary Ammo. "Lightweight Frame bows have not been meta within PvE but are strong contenders for quick double taps and follow up shots. Kill Clip is the best damage perk you have and will refresh on every shot but Whistler’s Whim just doesn't have the perk pool to go higher than low tier PvE or Gambit."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Draw Time. Lightweight(850) Kinetic Combat Bow Primary Ammo. "In PvP you can definitely make a use case for bow-swapping but Lightweights are also outclassed by the damage of precision frames. You can certainly make this bow work with Rangefinder for a faster arrow and Opening Shot to ensure the first shot lands, but you’ll have to have a plan for every shot."

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): Recommended MW: Draw Time. Lightweight(850) Kinetic Combat Bow Primary Ammo. "In PvP you can definitely make a use case for bow-swapping but Lightweights are also outclassed by the damage of precision frames. You can certainly make this bow work with Rangefinder for a faster arrow and Opening Shot to ensure the first shot lands, but you’ll have to have a plan for every shot."

pandapaxxy (PvE Controller \ M+KB): Recommended MW: Accuracy “I feel like this will be a havil sought after weapon. For two reasons, adept mods, and kill clip. Being a lightweight frame combat bow, Whistler's Whim does not need a lot to hit the draw time floor. Polymer string is enough and you will not have to sacrifice as much accuracy to do so. I do not think kill clip is the play for PvE but you can certainly make it work and I would love to see it. Look for other damage increasing perks like swash or AJ.“ (Year 5 S18: Season of Plunder Kinetic Bow Primary Ammo)

pandapaxxy (PvP Controller): Recommended MW: Accuracy “In PvP kill clip alone will not be able to one shot every resilience of guardian, but with radiant or an empowering rift, or really any other damage bonus you will be able to. In a team setting you should call out anyone with this bow just on the off-chance someone else is running Lumina or an empowering rift. It will be efficient with a team, but fall off in solo-play.“ (Year 5 S18: Season of Plunder Kinetic Bow Primary Ammo)
